svg.aria-label: Eight parts, each with an icon: pacing reads your limits and picks one of four levels; the ledger keeps every request word for word; proof, a fresh reviewer answers PASS or FAIL; lanes, each piece gets its own session; lessons, what you keep correcting becomes a lesson; guards, scripts on every tool call with no model tokens; privacy, no telemetry and no account; Brote, a small pet whose mood follows your week
